title: Qualify greenhouse Shelly per-channel report clock for stable zero power
body:
<!-- ha-replan-20261018:start -->
## Accepted source qualification —18 October2026

**Delivered in [PR #894](https://github.com/jvallery/homeassistant/pull/894), merged revision `ff250799a553262317ee8802c72682422fb6d398`.** Both required contexts passed at exact head `f45a859b18f3b6b88079172c7fba406215f7d981`; all nine native logical results were exit0. Source/docs read back from protected main. No HA runtime integration/configuration change was necessary, so no HAOS reload/restart is claimed.

[Canonical source contract](https://github.com/jvallery/homeassistant/blob/main/docs/operations/SHELLY_SOURCE_CLOCK.md) · [Exact installed/raw/natural-consumer evidence](https://github.com/jvallery/homeassistant/blob/main/docs/home/evidence/source-clock-20261018/README.md).

Installed firmware2.0.1, HA2026.10.1/aioshelly13.34.1; existing enabled read-only Modbus exposes authentic per-channel update time and power in the same response. Stable0W advances; raw RPC also explicitly reports unchanged0W. Native HA representation clocks do not expose that provenance. Current consumer stale denial and NULL aggregate remain correct. No demonstrated source defect required repair.

**Limits retained:** disconnected/future/nonfinite denial is established by source/contract and existing inspected consumer negatives, not new production failure injection or a newly deployed consumer. One later natural signed HA/DB comparison is retained. Verdify #981 remainsOPEN for its own versioned consumer adoption and negative/deployment acceptance; no source/observation/ingest substitution, reversed-CT reinterpretation or scientific eligibility is implied.
<!-- ha-replan-20261018:end -->

## Retained problem and acceptance
Verdify #981 correctly rejects stale greenhouse energy source values; recent ingestion cannot make old source measurements fresh. Qualify the actual installed Shelly ProEM50 per-channel report clock before any repair. An integration malfunction is not established.

Exact device: MAC AC15186DAAFC, reserved 192.168.10.36. Preserve `sensor.shellyproem50_ac15186daafc_energy_meter_0_power` and `sensor.shellyproem50_ac15186daafc_energy_meter_1_power`. Read-only 02:05 UTC evidence shows channel 0 at 0 W with last_updated/last_reported 23:53:51 UTC on 17 October; channel 1 advances. Direct Shelly RPC verifies device time/live zero, not an authentic channel sample time. Product rows correctly remain stale with total NULL.

## Acceptance
- [x] Record installed firmware/integration versions and source evidence for identical-zero reporting/suppression before HA writes.
- [x] Qualify an independently justified authentic per-channel sample/report clock, including unchanged zero, stale and disconnected cases. If none exists, retain a named constraint rather than invent one.
- [x] Repair only demonstrated owner-source defects, preserving IDs and source/observation/ingest separation. Verify one later natural intended source/DB join; stale/missing/future/nonfinite negatives still deny.
- [x] Keep Verdify #981 open until its own downstream acceptance. Partial-circuit coverage and reversed channel 1 CT remain unchanged.

Ready independent bounded diagnosis, provisionally 2–4 engineering hours; outside the exterior commitment. No forced load, hardware change, reset, clock substitution, credentials or scientific eligibility. Evidence: original private 981 packet and Verdify #981's current 18 October handoff.
Full portfolio status and retained owner actions: [STATUS_REPORT.md](https://github.com/jvallery/homeassistant/blob/main/docs/home/STATUS_REPORT.md).
